correctness.summary: The separator is correct. For the 4-cycle shift P and B=diag(1,0,1,0), B is idempotent and P^nBP^n=Σ_i b_{i+n}E_{i,i+2n}. Equality with B holds exactly for even n; for odd n the sandwich is off-diagonal while -B supplies nonzero diagonal entries. The displayed f_3 matrix recomputes exactly. For an L-cycle and diagonal projector D_S, f_n vanishes exactly when 2n≡0 mod L and S+n=S, apart from the zero projector, proving the stated classification.

limitations: No conclusion is reached on finite generation of the full ideal.
The monomial-cycle classification does not exclude non-monomial separators.
verify_parity.py, verify_monomial.py and parity_theorem.md referenced by the record are absent from the audited repository tree; this audit rederived the formulas directly.
Literature non-detection is not proof of novelty or priority.

originality.summary: The construction is an elementary explicit finite-dimensional separator. Focused searches did not locate the exact family a^n b a^n-b^{n+1}; current free-algebra Gröbner-basis literature concerns general methods rather than this parity representation. Non-detection is not used as a priority claim.

scientific_value.summary: It rigorously proves f_3∉(f_2) and closes the cycle-plus-projector ansatz, but it does not settle finite generation of the full infinite ideal.
